models.name: HS-250
models.assumption: The last year of returns is a fair sample of tomorrow's distribution

models.name: EWMA-0.94
models.assumption: Returns are conditionally normal with exponentially decaying memory

models.name: GARCH-t
models.method: GARCH(1,1), Student-t innovations, 750-day window, monthly re-fit
models.assumption: Volatility clusters and mean-reverts; tails are fat but symmetric

models.name: FHS
models.method: Filtered HS: GARCH volatility x empirical quantile of standardised residuals
models.assumption: Standardised residuals are i.i.d.; no distributional shape is imposed

findings.Finding: HS-250 under-covers 99% losses over the full sample
findings.Recommendation: Recalibrate or replace the model; report the coverage gap to the model owner.

findings.Evidence: Christoffersen independence p = 0.000: after one breach, another is more likely. HS reacts slowly when volatility jumps.
findings.Recommendation: Add volatility scaling (EWMA or GARCH filter) so VaR rises quickly in a stress.

findings.Finding: Basel traffic light reaches the Red zone
findings.Evidence: 4.1% of backtest days in Red; worst period Global financial crisis with 11 exceptions in 146 days.
findings.Recommendation: Quantify the capital impact of the plus factor; consider a stressed-VaR overlay.

findings.Finding: Challenger models forecast the tail significantly better
findings.Evidence: EWMA-0.94 (DM p = 0.003), GARCH-t (DM p = 0.003), FHS (DM p = 0.004) beat the model under review on quantile loss.
findings.Recommendation: Assess EWMA-0.94 as a replacement or as a benchmark in ongoing monitoring.

findings.Finding: Results depend materially on the look-back window
findings.Evidence: HS exceptions range from 93 (125 days), 73 (250 days), 58 (500 days), 41 (1000 days).
findings.Recommendation: Document the window choice and justify it with data.

findings.Evidence: Returns are i.i.d. (HS-250); Returns are normal; EWMA residuals are normal (EWMA-0.94); EWMA removes vol clustering.
findings.Recommendation: Record as a known limitation; monitor with the challenger models.
